## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name is `<type>/<description>` and commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] New or changed endpoints have a functional test per route
- [ ] Schema changes use a new migration (no edits to existing ones)
- [ ] New env vars are added to `.env.example` and validated at startup
- [ ] `docs/conventions.md` updated if a convention was added or changed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
